It does not include ping pong, darts, or a Spo-Cha section. / The arcade is located underneath Dick's Sporting Goods with three entrances; two located inside the mall, and an outside entrance. Indoor entrances: second floor entrance next to Dick's Sporting Goods indoor entrance, first floor entrance right below Dick's. Outdoor entrance: Located between the Macy's and L.L. Bean Entrances.
